def add_days_to_date_string_dmy(date_str, n):
    import datetime
    d, m, y = date_str.split('-')
    date = datetime.date(int(y), int(m), int(d))
    new_date = date + datetime.timedelta(days=n)
    return f"{new_date.day:02d}-{new_date.month:02d}-{new_date.year:04d}"

def invert_dict(d):
    return {v: k for k, v in d.items()}

def merge_keep_first(d1, d2):
    result = dict(d2)
    result.update(d1)
    return result

def merge_keep_last(d1, d2):
    result = dict(d1)
    result.update(d2)
    return result

def keys_intersection(d1, d2):
    return sorted(set(d1.keys()) & set(d2.keys()))

def keys_union(d1, d2):
    return sorted(set(d1.keys()) | set(d2.keys()))

def symmetric_difference_keys(d1, d2):
    return sorted(set(d1.keys()) ^ set(d2.keys()))
